title: The Napping House - Delightful 12 South Guesthouse
description:
Absolutely stunning guesthouse in the heart of 12 South.  Walkable to all 12 South has to offer and super close to Vanderbilt, Belmont, and other awesome neighborhoods like Hillsboro Village, The Gulch, Sylvan Park, as well as Broadway and the rest of downtown Nashville. Tucked in a quiet neighborhood, the guesthouse has its own private entrance and parking space.

The space
The Napping House is a gorgeous, brand-new build that is open concept with the living area and full kitchen. We hung blackout curtains in the bedroom to help you get solid rest, and the area is quiet at night.

Guest access
Please take care to not open the gates to our backyard (and we will forever be thankful to you if you notice one is open and close it for us!!). We have three very handsome rescue dogs, one of whom is a master escape artist and tough to catch once he’s free.
